CSS AREA: END------------------------------------------------------------------------*/ /*BAG - VAT INCLUDED FONT AMENDS - ECOM-2743: START*/ .CartPageTemplate .basketSummaryBlock .order-totals-container .vatText { font-size: var(--body-sm-size) !important; line-height: var(--body-sm-line-height) !important; } /*BAG - VAT INCLUDED FONT AMENDS - ECOM-2743: END*/ /***MAIN NAV NEW FLAG: START***/ .desktopMainNavNode .dropdown-nav .container.bespoke-dropdown span.newIn, .mobileNavLink.newInMob:after { background-color: var(--mid-grey-1); padding: 4px 8px; font-size: var(--heading-sm-size); font-family: var(--heading-font); text-transform: uppercase; font-weight: var(--heading-weight); letter-spacing: var(--heading-sm-tracking); margin-left: 4px; } .mobileNavLink.newInMob:after { content: "New"; margin-left: 8px; } /***MAIN NAV NEW FLAG: END***/ /***HIDES PAPYAL CREDIT BLOCK ON PLPS ONLY: START***/ #plpContainer .productTile .productTileText .productPaypalCreditBlock { display: none; } /***HIDES PAPYAL CREDIT BLOCK ON PLPS ONLY: END***/ /*HIDES TOTAL & DELIVERY IN MINI BAG: START*/ .itemAdded__totals { display: none; } /*HIDES TOTAL & DELIVERY IN MINI BAG: END*/ /* Z-index fix for Zoom overlaying checkout bag summary on mobile: Start */ @media(max-width:991px) { .SinglePageCheckoutTemplate .aurum-popup { z-index: 9991; } } /* Z-index fix for Zoom overlaying checkout bag summary on mobile: End */
